lines.en: label chinamidate10:
I tap on Chinami’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我点开手机里 Chinami 的名字，等她接。

lines.en: It’s still a little early, so I imagine Chika is getting ready to leave for work right about now.
lines.zh: 时间还早，所以我想 Chika 这会儿大概正准备出门上班。

lines.en: I don’t think I’ll ever come to terms with how strange the idea of me calling her little sister is, but it’s definitely getting less...weird over time.
lines.zh: 我想我永远没法完全接受「我给她妹妹打电话」这件事有多奇怪，不过随着时间推移，它确实变得没那么……怪了。

lines.en: Kind of.
lines.zh: 算是吧。

lines.en: I don’t know. Chinami is strangely fun to be around at times.
lines.zh: 我也不知道。Chinami 有时候相处起来有种古怪的乐趣。

lines.en: Even if that strange sense of fun comes from the fact that she may or may not be some sort of super-genius disguising herself as a little girl.
lines.zh: 哪怕这份古怪的乐趣，来自她也许是个伪装成小女孩的超级天才这件事。

lines.en: I’m calling your bluff, Chinami. You’re up to something.
lines.zh: 我才不信你那套呢，Chinami。你肯定在盘算什么。

lines.en: : Good morning, future dad!
lines.zh: : 早上好，未来的爸爸!

lines.en: : Good morning, Chinami. I am not your future dad.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Chinami。我不是你未来的爸爸。

lines.en: : But big sis says she’s pregnant with your baby.
lines.zh: : 可姐姐说她怀着你的宝宝。

lines.en: : That is literally impossible.
lines.zh: : 那在生理上根本不可能。

lines.en: : No! You two kissed and that’s how babies happen!
lines.zh: : 不对!你们俩亲嘴了，宝宝就是这么来的!

lines.en: : First, don’t ever say anything like that around Yumi.
lines.zh: : 第一，绝对别在 Yumi 面前说这种话。

lines.en: : Second, you know damn well that isn’t how babies are made, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 第二，你他妈心里清楚宝宝根本不是这么造出来的，Chinami。

lines.en: : No one will tell Chinami where they really come from so she has to keep guessing until she gets it right.
lines.zh: : 谁都不肯告诉 Chinami 宝宝到底是从哪儿来的，所以她只能一直猜，直到猜对为止。

lines.en: : Or Chinami can just drop it.
lines.zh: : 或者 Chinami 也可以干脆别问了。

lines.en: : And never get a little sister? No way, future dad!
lines.zh: : 那不就永远没有妹妹了？才不要，未来的爸爸!

lines.en: : Hold my sister’s hand and get her pregnant!
lines.zh: : 牵着我姐姐的手，让她怀上!

lines.en: : Wrong again.
lines.zh: : 又错了。

lines.en: : Rats!
: Is Chika home right now?
lines.zh: : Chika 现在在家吗?

lines.en: : Big sis left a few minutes ago. She looked extra pretty today.
lines.zh: : 姐姐几分钟前走了。她今天格外漂亮。

lines.en: : The perfect kind of look for getting knock-
lines.zh: : 正适合被搞大肚子的那种——

lines.en: : I’m going to hang up now.
lines.zh: : 我要挂电话了。

lines.en: : Wait! Chinami wants you to come visit!
lines.zh: : 等等!Chinami 想让你过来玩!

lines.en: : She is very bored and promises to not talk about babies!
lines.zh: : 她很无聊，保证不再提宝宝的事!

lines.en: : Fine. I’m on my way.
lines.zh: : 好吧。我这就过去。

lines.en: : I’m leaving the second you start saying things like that again, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你要是又开始说那种话，我立马就走。

lines.en: : There are two girls you’re very familiar with who would kill me if I was anywhere near a discussion of that nature.
lines.zh: : 有两个你很熟的姑娘，要是知道我参与了这种话题，会杀了我的。

lines.en: : Blah blah blah.
lines.zh: : 吧啦吧啦吧啦。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t understand what the big deal is, but she’s got a meeting coming up, so you better hurry before the doors are closed for good!
lines.zh: : Chinami 不懂有什么大不了的，不过她马上要开会，所以你最好快点，免得大门永久关上!

lines.en: : Bye-bye, future dad!
lines.zh: : 拜拜，未来的爸爸!

lines.en: Chinami hangs up the phone and I’m suddenly left wondering why I even called her in the first place.
lines.zh: Chinami 挂了电话，我突然开始纳闷，我一开始到底是为什么要打给她。

lines.en: All of those things I said about how she’s fun to be around-
lines.zh: 我刚才说的那些「她相处起来很有趣」的话——

lines.en: They were all lies.
lines.zh: 全都是谎话。

lines.en: She’s out to destroy me.
lines.zh: 她是来毁掉我的。

lines.en: I know she is.
lines.zh: 我知道她就是。

lines.en: scene black
scene chinamibalcony1
: Greetings, mortal! It is I, Chinami!
lines.zh: : 你好啊，凡人!正是我，Chinami!

lines.en: : Good morning, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 早上好，Chinami。

lines.en: : Lucky for you, Chinami’s meeting just ended.
lines.zh: : 你运气不错，Chinami 的会议刚结束。

lines.en: : She has all the time in the world now.
lines.zh: : 她现在有的是时间。

lines.en: : Who was your meeting with, exactly?
lines.zh: : 你到底是跟谁开的会?

lines.en: : So, you know how Chinami-Corp is the leading distributor of giraffes and giraffe paraphernalia in all of Japan?
lines.zh: : 那个，你知道 Chinami 公司是日本首屈一指的长颈鹿及长颈鹿周边分销商吧?

lines.en: : Also, since when has your vocabulary expanded to include those words?
lines.zh: : 还有，你什么时候学会用这些词的?

lines.en: : Chinami has had five thousand years to practice vocabulary. It was only a matter of time.
lines.zh: : Chinami 有五千年可以练词汇。早晚的事罢了。

lines.en: : Right, right. Please proceed with your giraffe stuff. Sorry for interrupting.
lines.zh: : 对对。请继续讲你的长颈鹿业务。抱歉打断你了。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony2
: It’s okay. Chinami understands that not everyone can be as business savvy as her.
lines.zh: : 没关系。Chinami 明白，不是谁都能像她这样有商业头脑。

lines.en: : You see, future dad, Chinami-Corp has acquired another company this morning.
lines.zh: : 你听好，未来的爸爸，Chinami 公司今天早上又收购了一家公司。

lines.en: : It was a big acquisition! One that will make Chinami so much money that she can start making microtransactions in her pig game!
lines.zh: : 那可是一笔大收购!大到 Chinami 能赚很多钱，多到她可以在她的杀猪游戏里开始氪金了!

lines.en: : I don’t follow gaming, but I’m pretty sure microtransactions aren’t at the point where you need to own a company to make them yet.
lines.zh: : 我不太关注游戏，不过我敢肯定，氪金还没到需要你拥有一家公司才能氪的地步。

lines.en: : You’d be surprised.
lines.zh: : 你会惊讶的。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony3
: Wanna buy an elephant? It would make Chinami very happy and the recent merger has added them to the Chinami-Corp catalogue!
lines.zh: : 想买头大象吗？那会让 Chinami 非常开心，而且最近的合并已经把它们加进了 Chinami 公司的商品目录!

lines.en: : No. Chinami-Corp still hasn’t even given me the giraffes I accidentally ordered.
lines.zh: : 不买。Chinami 公司连我不小心下单的长颈鹿都还没给我呢。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony4
: Pweeeeeeeeeeeease?~
lines.zh: : 求——求你了嘛?~

lines.en: Your tricks won’t work on me, demon.
lines.zh: 你的把戏对我没用，恶魔。

lines.en: : I hope I didn’t come all this way just for you to try and sell me things again.
lines.zh: : 但愿我不是大老远跑来，就为了让你再向我推销东西。

lines.en: : It’s not exactly a short walk, you know.
lines.zh: : 这路可不算近，你知道的。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony5
: Chinami doesn’t know. The only time she’s allowed to go outside is when she’s with big sis Chika.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道。她只有跟 Chika 姐姐在一起的时候才能出门。

lines.en: : She used to be allowed outside with big sis Yumi, but not since the peanut incident.
lines.zh: : 以前跟 Yumi 姐姐在一起也可以外出，不过花生事件之后就不行了。

lines.en: : The what now?
lines.zh: : 什么事件?

lines.en: : Chinami is very allergic to peanuts and big sis Yumi let her eat some since she’s reckless and mature.
lines.zh: : Chinami 对花生严重过敏，而 Yumi 姐姐因为她鲁莽又自认为成熟，就让她吃了。

lines.en: : It’s not very mature to feed peanuts to someone who is allergic to them.
lines.zh: : 给对花生过敏的人喂花生，可算不上成熟。

lines.en: : It’s Chinami’s fault, too. She knew she was allergic and didn’t tell big sis Yumi about it.
lines.zh: : 这也是 Chinami 的错。她知道自己过敏，却没告诉 Yumi 姐姐。

lines.en: : Were you trying to get yourself killed?
lines.zh: : 你是想把自己弄死吗?

lines.en: : No! Chinami just likes nuts!
lines.zh: : 才不是!Chinami 只是喜欢坚果!

lines.en: There is a glaring issue with that statement but explaining {i}why{/i} would just cause me even more of a headache.
lines.zh: 这句话里有个明摆着的问题，可要解释{i}为什么{/i}，只会让我更头疼。

lines.en: I should write down to never give her anything with nuts, though. That seems like a big deal.
lines.zh: 不过我该记下来，永远别给她任何含坚果的东西。这看起来挺重要的。

lines.en: Is this what being a parent feels like?
lines.zh: 当父母就是这种感觉吗?

lines.en: : No. Parents don’t take notes on their kids.
lines.zh: : 不是。父母不会给自家孩子做笔记。

lines.en: : Future dad? Are you talking to yourself?
lines.zh: : 未来的爸爸？你在自言自语吗?

lines.en: : Do you need to take notes on Chinami even though you’re not married to big sis Chika yet?
lines.zh: : 你还没跟 Chika 姐姐结婚，就已经需要给 Chinami 做笔记了吗?

lines.en: : Do you need the Chinami-Corp quarterly spending report?
lines.zh: : 你需要 Chinami 公司的季度支出报告吗?

lines.en: : Where in the world are you learning all of these business terms?
lines.zh: : 你到底是从哪儿学来这些商业术语的?

lines.en: : Chinami has gotten really into the stock market lately and it’s opened a big can of worms!
lines.zh: : Chinami 最近迷上了股市，结果捅了个大篓子!

lines.en: : But big sis Chika wouldn’t let Chinami invest in GME and now they’re still poor instead of swimming in a giant pool of Jell-O.
lines.zh: : 可 Chika 姐姐不让 Chinami 投资 GME，所以她们现在还是很穷，没能在一大池子果冻里游泳。

lines.en: : You have a strange perception of what it is like to be rich.
lines.zh: : 你对有钱人的生活想象得挺奇怪。

lines.en: : Are you telling Chinami that you {i}wouldn’t{/i} swim in a giant pool of Jell-O?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你{i}不会{/i}在一大池子果冻里游泳吗?

lines.en: : I am. That doesn’t sound fun, it just sounds difficult.
lines.zh: : 对。听起来一点也不好玩，只觉得麻烦。

lines.en: : Future dad, can Chinami ask you a question?
lines.zh: : 未来的爸爸，Chinami 能问你一个问题吗?

lines.en: : As long as it isn’t about something that’s going to get me in trouble.
lines.zh: : 只要不是会让我惹上麻烦的事就行。

lines.en: : What is Jell-O?
lines.zh: : 果冻是什么?

lines.en: : Why do you want to swim in a pool of something if you don’t even know what it is?
lines.zh: : 你连那是什么都不知道，为什么还想在一池子那东西里游泳?

lines.en: : I heard it on TV.
lines.zh: : 我在电视上听到的。

lines.en: : It’s a...weird water based dessert thing that’s kind of...bouncy. It’s actually pretty gross.
lines.zh: : 那是一种……奇怪的、以水为基底的甜点，有点……Q弹。说实话挺恶心的。

lines.en: : Can we make Jell-O one day or is it only for rich people?
lines.zh: : 我们哪天能做果冻吗？还是说只有有钱人才吃得起?

lines.en: : It’s actually really cheap so...sure.
lines.zh: : 其实特别便宜，所以……行啊。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony6
: Hooray! Chinami is gonna eat a bouncy dessert with her new dad!
lines.zh: : 万岁!Chinami 要和她的新的爸爸一起吃 Q 弹的甜点啦!

lines.en: : It will have to wait for another day, though. I obviously didn’t bring any with me this time.
lines.zh: : 不过得改天了。我这次显然没带。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony7
: It’s okay~ Chinami had other plans for today.
lines.zh: : 没关系~ Chinami 今天另有安排。

lines.en: : And she asked big sis Chika already, who said it’s okay as long as Chinami puts her scarf on first.
lines.zh: : 而且她已经问过 Chika 姐姐了，姐姐说只要 Chinami 先围上围巾就行。

lines.en: : Your scarf? Why?
lines.zh: : 围巾？为什么?

lines.en: : I’m not allowed to take you outside, am I? Not even Yumi is allowed to do that.
lines.zh: : 我不能带你出门吧？连 Yumi 都不行。

lines.en: : Because big sis Yumi tried to assassinate Chinami.
lines.zh: : 因为 Yumi 姐姐曾经想暗杀 Chinami。

lines.en: : You’re not an assassin, are you?
lines.zh: : 你不是刺客吧?

lines.en: : Please don't kill Chinami! She loves you!
lines.zh: : 请不要杀 Chinami!她很爱你!

lines.en: : Not...that I’m aware of.
lines.zh: : 应该……不是吧。

lines.en: : Then everything is okay!
lines.zh: : 那就一切都没问题了!

lines.en: I’m not sure how I feel about this.
lines.zh: 我不确定自己对此是什么感觉。

lines.en: I felt weird enough even walking around the mall with Chinami.
lines.zh: 光是带着 Chinami 在商场里逛逛，我就已经够不自在了。

lines.en: Taking her outside, especially in this part of town, seems like an accident waiting to happen.
lines.zh: 带她出门，尤其是在这一带，简直像是在等事故发生。

lines.en: There’s no way I could let myself be responsible for something like that.
lines.zh: 我绝不能让自己为那种事负责。

lines.en: : I don’t think it’s a good idea for you to go outside, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你出门不是个好主意，Chinami。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony8
: But...but Chinami got permission.
lines.zh: : 可……可 Chinami 得到许可了啊。

lines.en: : Even {i}if{/i} Chinami got permission, what if something bad happened to you?
lines.zh: : {i}就算{/i} Chinami 得到了许可，万一你出了什么事怎么办?

lines.en: : You would protect Chinami because you love her.
lines.zh: : 你会保护 Chinami 的，因为你爱她。

lines.en: : I have never once said I love you, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 我可从没说过我爱你，Chinami。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony9
: Two dads in a row don’t love Chinami! Is she doomed to live a life of sadness?!
lines.zh: : 连续两个爸爸都不爱 Chinami!她注定要过一辈子悲伤的人生吗?!

lines.en: : Okay, fine. I love you. Just...don’t bring up how your real dad didn’t ever again.
lines.zh: : 好吧，好吧。我爱你。只是……别再提你亲爸从来没说过这种话了。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony10
: So this is what love feels like...
lines.zh: : 原来这就是被爱的感觉啊……

lines.en: : Her real dad is missing out on something big!
lines.zh: : 她亲爸可是错过了不得了的东西!

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony4
: Can Chinami really not go outside, though? She was very excited...
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 真的不能出门吗？她本来超期待的……

lines.en: : She can’t.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: : I don’t even know my way around this part of town.
lines.zh: : 我对这一带根本不熟悉。

lines.en: : And if Yumi ever saw me walking around with you, she’d-
lines.zh: : 而且要是 Yumi 看见我带着你在外面走，她会——

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony11
: Wait.
lines.zh: : 等等。

lines.en: : Chinami thinks she may have left out an important detail.
lines.zh: : Chinami 觉得她可能漏掉了一个重要细节。

lines.en: : Chinami didn’t expect to walk around the town.
lines.zh: : Chinami 没打算在镇上逛。

lines.en: : She just wanted to stand on the balcony for a little while and then get cold and go back inside.
lines.zh: : 她只是想在阳台上站一会儿，等冷了就回屋里。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Why did you need to ask for permission to stand on the balcony?
lines.zh: : 站阳台为什么要申请许可?

lines.en: : Because Chinami tried to climb the railing once when she was little and almost fell down and died.
lines.zh: : 因为 Chinami 小时候有一次想爬栏杆，差点摔下去摔死。

lines.en: : Now Chinami asks every time just to be safe.
lines.zh: : 所以现在 Chinami 每次都会问一声，图个保险。

lines.en: : Just to clarify, when you asked your sister for permission, did you say anything about me being here?
lines.zh: : 我确认一下，你跟你姐姐申请的时候，有提过我在这儿吗?

lines.en: : Not today. Chinami thought you were just coming over for business reasons.
lines.zh: : 今天没提。Chinami 以为你只是来谈生意的。

lines.en: : Please assume from this point forward that I will {i}never{/i} be coming here for business reasons.
lines.zh: : 从今往后，请默认我{i}永远{/i}不会为了生意上的事来这儿。

lines.en: : That’s okay. Chinami no longer has any use for you because of the merger.
lines.zh: : 没关系。因为合并的关系，Chinami 已经用不上你了。

lines.en: : She wishes you good luck with your future endeavors.
lines.zh: : 她祝你在未来的事业上一帆风顺。

lines.en: You know, I’m kind of thankful Chinami can’t go to a regular[school].
lines.zh: 说起来，我还挺庆幸 Chinami 上不了普通[school]。

lines.en: I can’t imagine there are many other girls her age (5,000) that would know how to deal with her.
lines.zh: 我真想象不出，还有多少跟她同龄（五千岁）的女孩知道该怎么应付她。

lines.en: : Go put your scarf on, Chinami. We’ll go stand on your balcony for a little while if that’s really what you want to do.
lines.zh: : 去把围巾戴上，Chinami。要是你真想，我们就去阳台上站一会儿。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony12
: VICTORY FOR CHINAMI! THERE {i}IS{/i} A GOD!
lines.zh: : CHINAMI 大获全胜!世上{i}真的有{/i}神!

lines.en: scene black
Chinami sprints into the bedroom and pulls open a drawer, removing a long white scarf out of it and wrapping it around her neck.
lines.zh: Chinami 冲进卧室，拉开抽屉，从里面抽出一条长长的白围巾，缠在脖子上。

lines.en: She closes the drawer with so much force that the picture of her mother falls over.
lines.zh: 她关抽屉时力气太大，把她妈妈的照片震倒了。

lines.en: Chinami gasps in shock as this happens and then apologizes to the picture as if it still has the potential to feel.
lines.zh: Chinami 惊得倒吸一口气，然后向那张照片道歉，就好像它还能感受到什么似的。

lines.en: She sits it upright once again, among a circle of candles, before running toward the back door and sliding it open, stepping aside for me to meet her out there.
lines.zh: 她把照片重新立好，放回那圈蜡烛中间，然后跑到后门边把门拉开，让到一旁等我过去。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony13
: Wow!
: Chinami has been stuck inside for so long that she forgot what the sun even looks like!
lines.zh: : Chinami 在屋里待太久了，都快忘了太阳长什么样了!

lines.en: : It hurts so much more looking at it from outside instead of behind the window!
lines.zh: : 从外面看，比隔着窗户看刺眼多了!

lines.en: : Please don’t stare directly at the sun, Chinami. You’ll go blind.
lines.zh: : 别直视太阳，Chinami。会瞎的。

lines.en: : Blindness-shmindness! Gimme those UV rays! Chinami finally feels alive!
lines.zh: : 瞎不瞎的!把紫外线都给我!Chinami 终于觉得自己活过来了!

lines.en: : How long has it been since you’ve been out here? This is a hell of a reaction.
lines.zh: : 你多久没出门了？这反应也太夸张了。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony14
: Chinami last went outside three days ago.
lines.zh: : Chinami 上一次出门是三天前。

lines.en: : That is nowhere near long enough to warrant this type of reaction.
lines.zh: : 三天可远远不至于有这种反应。

lines.en: : Everything seems longer when you’re stuck inside, future dad.
lines.zh: : 被困在屋里的时候，什么时间都显得更长，未来的爸爸。

lines.en: : Even forty-five minute TV shows feel more like an hour!
lines.zh: : 连四十五分钟的电视节目都感觉像一小时!

lines.en: : And since Chinami has to study at night, the day time is the only time she gets to be a free woman.
lines.zh: : 而且 Chinami 晚上要学习，白天是她唯一能做自由人的时候。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony15
: But one day, Chinami is gonna have her very own house and she’ll be able to stand on the balcony without asking permission.
lines.zh: : 不过总有一天，Chinami 会有自己的房子，到时候她想站阳台就不用请示了。

lines.en: : And she’ll also have a horse, and a dog, and a plasma screen television, and a pool full of Jell-O.
lines.zh: : 而且她还会有一匹马、一只狗、一台等离子电视，还有一整池子的果冻。

lines.en: : And she’ll come visit you...and big sis Chika...{i}and{/i} big sis Yumi every single weekend.
lines.zh: : 然后她每个周末都会来看你……还有 Chika 姐姐……{i}还有{/i} Yumi 姐姐。

lines.en: : Yumi is going to be there too?
lines.zh: : Yumi 也会在吗?

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony16
: Of course!
lines.zh: : 当然了!

lines.en: : You have to marry both of them so you can be Chinami’s full dad instead of her half dad.
lines.zh: : 你得把她们俩都娶了，这样你才能当 Chinami 的完整的爸爸，而不是半个爸爸。

lines.en: : And then you can marry Chinami too and we can all move into my house with the horse and the Jell-O pool.
lines.zh: : 然后你还可以娶 Chinami，我们就能一起搬进我的房子，跟那匹马和果冻池住在一起。

lines.en: : You do realize you don’t have to marry someone to live with them, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道住在一起不一定要结婚吧?

lines.en: : But you’re a boy and we’re all girls. Obviously we’d have to get married to live together. Isn’t that the rule?
lines.zh: : 可你是男生，我们都是女生。要住在一起显然就得结婚啊。这不是规矩吗?

lines.en: : Again, no. That is not the rule.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，不是。这不是规矩。

lines.en: : So you love all of us but don’t want to marry us? Are you cheap, future dad?
lines.zh: : 所以你爱我们所有人，却不想娶我们？未来的爸爸，你是小气吗?

lines.en: : Is it because you spent all of your money on our phones?
lines.zh: : 是因为你把钱都花在给我们买手机上了吗?

lines.en: : Is that why Chinami can’t make microtransactions?
lines.zh: : 所以 Chinami 才不能氪金吗?

lines.en: : It has a little more to do with there being...different types of love.
lines.zh: : 这更多是因为……爱有不同类型。

lines.en: : That sounds too adult for Chinami to understand. She’d rather talk about quarterly sales reports and GME’s impact on the modern economy.
lines.zh: : 这个太大人了，Chinami 听不懂。她宁愿聊季度销售报告，还有 GME 对现代经济的影响。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony17
: But she still hopes you’ll marry one of her sisters one day.
lines.zh: : 不过她还是希望，有一天你能娶她两个姐姐中的一个。

lines.en: : They both like you a lot.
lines.zh: : 她们都很喜欢你。

lines.en: : Big sis Yumi, too. Even though she likes to pretend she doesn’t.
lines.zh: : Yumi 姐姐也是。哪怕她总装作不喜欢。

lines.en: : And Chinami likes you just as much! She’s really happy every time you come over to visit.
lines.zh: : Chinami 也一样喜欢你!你每次来看她，她都特别开心。

lines.en: : You talk to her like a normal girl and not a baby. She appreciates that.
lines.zh: : 你跟她说话时，是把她当普通女孩，而不是小宝宝。她很感激这一点。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} appreciate that.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}很感激。

lines.en: scene chinamibalcony18
: Thank you for spending time with me.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你陪我。

lines.en: : Come over and play more, kay?
lines.zh: : 以后常来玩，好吗?

lines.en: scene black
I always feel a little strange when Chinami stops referring to herself in the third person.
lines.zh: 每当 Chinami 不再用第三人称称呼自己，我总觉得有点不自在。

lines.en: But I need to remember that she’s a lot smarter than she lets on.
lines.zh: 但我得记住，她比表面上看起来的要聪明得多。

lines.en: She really takes after her sister in that regard.
lines.zh: 在这一点上，她真的很像她姐姐。

lines.en: The one {i}actually{/i} related to her. Not the one who can’t even be bothered to come to[school] every day.
lines.zh: 是那个跟她{i}真正{/i}有血缘关系的姐姐。而不是那个连每天去[school]都懒得去的。

lines.en: I guess the Chosokabes are just...naturally smart and wholesome.
lines.zh: 我想长宗我部家的人大概就是……天生聪明又善良。

lines.en: It’s really unfortunate that they were dealt the hand they were.
lines.zh: 她们摊上这样的命运，真的很不幸。

lines.en: But I guess that just gives me even more incentive to keep spending time with them.
lines.zh: 不过我想，这反而让我更有动力继续陪着她们。

lines.en: Even if I have to keep coming all the way to the worst part of Kumon-mi to see them, their excitement every time I arrive makes it all worth it...
lines.zh: 哪怕我得一次次跑到 Kumon-mi 最乱的这片地方来看她们，每次我到时她们那股兴奋劲儿，就让我觉得一切都值了……
